bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
ipc="$root/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py"
helper="$root/scripts/userbot_link_photo_caption_smoke.py"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 61
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 62
test -f "$ipc" && test ! -L "$ipc" && test ! -e "$helper" || exit 63
owner="$(cat "$root/deploy/secrets/bug_report_userbot_account.txt")"
[[ "$owner" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]{3,18}$ ]] || exit 64
safe="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT CASE WHEN step='preview' AND data->>'text' IN ('Rich編集の安全テスト','個別編集済みの安全テスト') AND NOT data ? 'shareCode' THEN 'TEST_ONLY' ELSE 'OTHER' END FROM public_post_drafts WHERE owner_user_id=$owner AND module='link';" 2>/dev/null)" || exit 65
test "$safe" = TEST_ONLY || exit 66
git -C "$root" fetch --no-tags origin refs/heads/chat/link-button-master-final-20261120 >/dev/null
test "$(git -C "$root" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = 01bd0bc0c2d192e88dc8b965ad31586eff1a3868 || exit 67
temp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/link-photo-caption.XXXXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$temp"' EXIT
git -C "$root" show FETCH_HEAD:scripts/userbot_link_photo_caption_smoke.py >"$temp/helper.py"
cp -p "$ipc" "$temp/original.py"
python3 -B - "$ipc" "$temp" <<'PY'
import ast,sys
from pathlib import Path
f,t=map(Path,sys.argv[1:]);s=f.read_text(encoding="utf8")
def once(a,b):
 global s
 if s.count(a)!=1:raise SystemExit(68)
 s=s.replace(a,b,1)
once('"link_send_saved_smoke",','"link_send_saved_smoke", "link_photo_caption_smoke",')
once('    if action == "link_send_saved_smoke":',
'''    if action == "link_photo_caption_smoke":
        from userbot_link_photo_caption_smoke import run
        return {"request_id":request_id,**await run(client)}
    if action == "link_send_saved_smoke":''')
once('                response = await asyncio.wait_for(',
'''                if request.get("action") == "link_photo_caption_smoke":
                    response = await asyncio.wait_for(process_request(client, request),timeout=95)
                else:
                    response = await asyncio.wait_for(''')
ast.parse(s);ast.parse((t/"helper.py").read_text(encoding="utf8"))
(t/"updated.py").write_text(s,encoding="utf8")
PY
restore(){
 cp -p "$temp/original.py" "$ipc"
 rm -f "$helper"
 systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
}
trap restore ERR
cp "$temp/updated.py" "$ipc"
cp "$temp/helper.py" "$helper"
systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service
sleep 4
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 69
python3 -B - "$root" <<'PY'
import asyncio,json,os,stat,sys,uuid
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(sys.argv[1]);sys.path.insert(0,str(root/"scripts"))
from userbot_resident_ipc import SOCKET_PATH
if not SOCKET_PATH.is_socket() or SOCKET_PATH.is_symlink():sys.exit(70)
st=SOCKET_PATH.stat()
if st.st_uid!=os.getuid() or stat.S_IMODE(st.st_mode)!=0o600:sys.exit(71)
async def invoke(action):
 reader,writer=await asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.open_unix_connection(str(SOCKET_PATH)),5)
 try:
  rid=uuid.uuid4().hex
  writer.write((json.dumps({"request_id":rid,"action":action})+"\n").encode());await writer.drain()
  line=await asyncio.wait_for(reader.readline(),115)
  if not line:sys.exit(72)
  result=json.loads(line)
  if result.get("request_id") not in (rid,None):sys.exit(73)
  if result.get("status")!="PASS":sys.exit(74)
  if action=="link_photo_caption_smoke":
   wanted=("photo_received","caption_input_sent","preview_ready","photo_registration_receipt")
   if not all(result.get(k) is True for k in wanted):sys.exit(75)
 finally:
  writer.close();await writer.wait_closed()
async def run():
 await invoke("health")
 await invoke("link_photo_caption_smoke")
 await invoke("health")
asyncio.run(run())
PY
after="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT CASE WHEN media_kind='photo' AND media_caption='画像の補足' AND content='' AND share_code IS NOT NULL THEN 'PHOTO_CAPTION_PERSISTED' ELSE 'BAD' END FROM link_button_posts WHERE owner_user_id=$owner AND status='draft' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1;" 2>/dev/null)" || exit 76
test "$after" = PHOTO_CAPTION_PERSISTED || exit 77
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 78
trap - ERR
echo LINK_PHOTO_UPLOAD_CAPTION_REGISTER=PASS
echo LINK_DB_PHOTO_CAPTION_READBACK=PASS
echo USERBOT_SESSION_PRESERVED=PASS
